## Summary

Describe the focused change and its motivation.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting passes
- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Race tests pass
- [ ] Integration tests pass, or the reason they were not run is documented
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes

## Public-repository privacy

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private keys, password hashes, or database exports
- [ ] No production domains, LAN addresses, hostnames, account IDs, or deployment inventories
- [ ] No real project names, notes, decisions, deadlines, or seed data
- [ ] Examples use fictional values and reserved example domains

## Security impact

Describe changes to authentication, authorization, token handling, network access, parsing bounds, or trust boundaries. Write `None` when not applicable.
